metadata.name: HyperBoostX Triple AI Engine Knowledge Base
positioning: AI Performance Doctor for Gaming PCs
AI Performance Tuning for NVIDIA RTX PCs
branding_guardrails: Do not claim Powered by NVIDIA.
Do not claim Official NVIDIA Partner.

tweak_database.name: Set Performance Power Plan
tweak_database.description: Switches Windows to a performance-oriented power plan when available.
tweak_database.notes: Can help latency or frame pacing, but FPS gains are not guaranteed.

tweak_database.name: Optimize Windows Visual Effects
tweak_database.description: Uses a reversible registry value for simpler visual effects.
tweak_database.notes: Low risk and suitable for Safe Boost.

tweak_database.name: Enable Windows Game Mode
tweak_database.description: Enables Windows Game Mode for the current user.
tweak_database.notes: May help Windows prioritize game workloads; results depend on game and system state.

tweak_database.name: Disable Xbox Game Bar Capture Overlay
tweak_database.description: Disables GameDVR capture overlay for the current user.
tweak_database.notes: Useful only if overlay/capture is causing stutter.

tweak_database.name: Reduce Telemetry Policy
tweak_database.description: Adjusts telemetry policy values where Windows edition permits it.
tweak_database.notes: Must be explained clearly and applied only after approval.

tweak_database.name: Disable Windows Security Protection
tweak_database.description: Attempts to disable Windows Security protection.

tweak_database.name: Disable Windows Update Permanently
tweak_database.description: Attempts to disable automatic Windows updates.

recommended_mid_vram: High textures if VRAM headroom exists
known_issues: frame pacing can drop with heavy background apps

recommended_mid_vram: Reflex On + Boost if thermals are stable
known_issues: CPU bottleneck is common at high refresh rates
UE5 settings can be VRAM heavy

recommended_low_vram: cap FPS if frame time is unstable

nvidia_setting_database.recommended_value: On when supported; On + Boost only if thermals are stable
nvidia_setting_database.explanation: Can help reduce render queue latency in supported games.
nvidia_setting_database.revert_method: set Reflex to Off or default in the game menu

nvidia_setting_database.recommended_value: Quality for image quality, Balanced for heavier games, Performance for high resolution targets
nvidia_setting_database.explanation: Can improve stability or headroom depending on game and resolution.
nvidia_setting_database.revert_method: set upscaling to native/off in the game menu

nvidia_setting_database.recommended_value: Use only when base FPS and latency feel stable
nvidia_setting_database.use_case: single-player or visually rich games on supported RTX GPUs
nvidia_setting_database.explanation: Can make motion look smoother but does not replace low-latency tuning.

nvidia_setting_database.recommended_value: Usually Off for competitive games; use cap/VRR strategy for smoothness
nvidia_setting_database.explanation: Wrong V-Sync choices can add latency or tearing depending on display setup.
nvidia_setting_database.revert_method: restore default in game or NVIDIA app/control panel

backup_requirements.high: manual only with restore point; no auto apply

symptoms: GPU usage low while FPS is low

safe_fixes: clean DirectX shader cache with approval

benchmark_database.notes: Use as recommendation context only; never claim guaranteed FPS uplift.
